builds.name: Unstable Matter ceiling
builds.summary: Unstable Matter deals 80+(.08+.0003 AP)*target max HP magic damage. At 3000 target HP each AP gives .9 raw W damage, rewarding AP/penetration over self HP.
builds.goal: Unstable Matter deals 80+(.08+.0003 AP)*target max HP magic damage. At 3000 target HP each AP gives .9 raw W damage, rewarding AP/penetration over self HP.
builds.hypothesis:
Zac's body erupts, dealing [40 / 50 / 60 / 70 / 80] + [(4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 + (0.03) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage to nearby enemies.

Absorbing Goo reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 1 second.
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

One W against fixed max-HP champion; no blobs or R, compare 6000-HP target only as separate benchmark. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.

Highest-number candidate, not proof of mathematical maximum. Use current stored source values and verify all conditional multipliers. Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Shadowflame, Zhonya's Hourglass, Banshee's Veil, Riftmaker. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

builds.name: Elastic Slingshot: AP landing nuke
builds.summary: Explore a large Elastic Slingshot landing number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Explore a large Elastic Slingshot landing number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 E is 240 + 0.8 AP magic damage. Charging changes access and crowd control, not this damage coefficient. Deathcap scales AP; Void and Shadowflame compete with additional AP against MR. Riftmaker's fully ramped 8% damage and HP-to-AP conversion are a conditional alternative to a pure 105-AP slot. Zac has no mana, so Seraph and Muramana are excluded.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, maximum target rank, game time 30 minutes, no elixir, dragons or allied buffs. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 900 current HP, 100 armor and 50 MR before any explicitly tested debuff. Owner starts at full HP. No free permanent stacks. E legally charged before the scored landing. Riftmaker already at its four-second maximum ramp from separate champion combat; setup damage is excluded. No extra Heartsteel HP. Target starts below Shadowflame's threshold. Record raw potential separately from effective damage; do not count packets after the target dies.

kitEvidence.formula:
Begin Charging: Zac pulls himself taut, charging up a dash over [0.9 / 1 / 1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3] seconds.

Release: Zac launches himself and Knocks Up enemies where he lands for up to [(0.5) × (2)] second (based on charge time), dealing them [60 / 105 / 150 / 195 / 240 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage. Zac spawns an extra chunk of Goo for each enemy champion hit.
